slot.brief: Sentence where the preposition is followed by an infinitive/base verb instead of the gerund; student spots that part.

stem:
Find the part of the sentence which contains an error.

The committee considered / postponing the launch / rather than approve / the incomplete proposal.

verdicts.working: “Postponing” is a gerund, so the parallel form is “rather than approving.” The error is in part (C).
